question: The Chairman of National Human Rights Commission should be:

options.text: a speaker of the Lok Sabha
a retired Chief Justice of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**a retired Chief Justice of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **National Human Rights Commission **(NHRC) of India is an autonomous public body constituted on **12 October 1993 **under the **Protection of Human Rights Ordinance **of **28, 1993**.
